summary.zh: 地块系统把学校地图拆分为可点击、可统计、可行动的 Province 区域，是地图玩法和学生分布的基础。
summary.en: The province system divides the school map into clickable, trackable, and actionable provinces. It is the foundation of map gameplay and student distribution.

items.zh: 地块基于 Province 色块索引图识别。
items.en: Provinces are identified through the province color index map.

items.zh: 玩家可以 hover 地块查看边界，并点击地块查看信息。
items.en: The player can hover over provinces to see borders and click them for information.

items.zh: 地块会记录名称、功能、巡逻、学生数量、支持率和压力等信息。
items.en: Provinces track data such as name, function, patrol level, student count, support, and pressure.

items.zh: 学生会根据年级和时间段自动分布到不同地块。
items.en: Students automatically distribute across provinces based on grade and time block.

items.zh: 地块学生人数包含普通学生和玩家阵营成员。
items.en: Province student count includes both normal students and player faction members.

items.zh: 组织成员列表可在地块信息中单独查看。
items.en: Organization members in a province can be viewed separately from the province panel.

items.zh: 地块支持率来自当前地块内学生信任度的平均值。
items.en: Province support is based on the average trust of students currently in that province.

items.zh: 地块压力来自当前地块内学生压力的平均值。
items.en: Province pressure is based on the average pressure of students currently in that province.

items.zh: 学生日程、区域行动和管理层状态都会影响地块数据。
items.en: Student schedules, region actions, and faculty state can all affect province data.

items.zh: 选中地块会打开地块信息面板。
items.en: Selecting a province opens the province information panel.

items.zh: 点击行动小队标记时，地块面板会让位给小队面板。
items.en: Clicking an action squad marker replaces the province panel with the squad panel.

items.zh: 总部选择和区域行动目标选择都依赖有效地块判断。
items.en: Headquarters selection and region action target selection both rely on valid province detection.
